aiExplanation.summary: This file verifies NotesViewProvider UI behavior, active-resource routing, Store-aware actions, and Note lifecycle workflows.
aiExplanation.detail:
- Toolbar context tests: Confirm both Detail and Navigator rebind Project Notes state to the active file and cursor line.
- Provider behavior tests: Cover resource rendering, navigation, Runtime State, relocation, AI generation, and Team or Personal Store forwarding.
- Section draft tests: Confirm draft display, cancellation, and non-empty persistence behavior.
